definitions.ops_turnslen3: both bot:false, brought 4+4, turns.length >= 3 (turn n===3 exists gives the identical set on every file)
definitions.quality_full: engine/quality.js reasons() empty, INCLUDING behaviouralBots() computed over the same file. The illegal-team and custom-ruleset verdicts are Reg M-B ladder id sets and remove 0 Reg M-C games
definitions.lower_higher: min / max of p1.rating and p2.rating as stored (pre-game ladder rating); null counts as 0
definitions.reveal: bo1: per `sets` entry (base and mega formes are separate entries), distinct moves capped at 4; item share over non-mega entries; ability share over all entries
definitions.scarf: bo3: per side sheet, any item ChoiceScarf. own_1300 = that side rated >= 1300
definitions.ladder: userid match (lowercase alnum) of store names to the ladder toplist; player_games_held counts player appearances
definitions.series: bo3 rows carry no bestof room id. Group by unordered player pair, sort by battle number, start a new series when the gap to the previous game exceeds gap_min, or the current series has 3 games or a player with 2 wins
